title: Bengaluru Namma Metro records 12.29% growth in ridership; fare revenue jumps 49% to ₹1,125 crore
points: Bengaluru Namma Metro recorded a 12.29% growth in ridership.
Fare revenue increased by 49.36% to reach 1,125.58 crore rupees for 2025-26.
BMRCL collected this revenue compared to 753.59 crore rupees in the previous year.

title: Supreme Court bars Tamil Nadu government from coercive action against SASTRA University over land dispute
points: The Supreme Court barred the Tamil Nadu government from taking coercive action against SASTRA University.
The case involves a dispute over 31.37 acres of government land in Thanjavur.
The Bench was headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant.

title: Supreme Court asks petitioner to move Allahabad High Court over ‘demolition’ of 100-year-old mosque at Saharanpur
points: The Supreme Court directed a petitioner to approach the Allahabad High Court.
The petition concerned the demolition of a 100-year-old mosque in Saharanpur.
The apex court stated that every alleged violation of its judgment cannot be brought directly to it.

title: Earthmover at Amarnath Yatra stopover Sheshnag lake draws outrage from parties and locals
points: An earthmover was spotted at the Sheshnag lake stopover during the Amarnath Yatra.
The incident drew widespread outrage from local parties and residents.
Demands were raised to ban heavy machinery in the ecologically fragile region.

title: TMC MLA Sabina Yeasmin appears before NIA in connection with ‘attacks’ on judicial officers
points: TMC MLA Sabina Yeasmin appeared before the NIA for questioning.
The probe is linked to attacks on judicial officers and a judge's vehicle.
The violence occurred in Kaliachak and Mothabari areas on April 1.

title: Ukraine says Russian strikes kill 15 in Kyiv region
points: Russian airstrikes killed 15 people in the Kyiv region of Ukraine.
Moscow has been conducting nightly aerial barrages before winter.
The full-scale invasion has entered its fifth year.

title: Indonesia says 24 killed in factory blaze as rescuers search for dozens missing
points: A factory blaze in Indonesia resulted in 24 deaths and numerous missing persons.
The fire occurred at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia confectionery factory in Cikande, Banten province.
The incident took place on the evening of November 21, 2026.

title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif to undertake official visit to Russia
points: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is scheduled to visit Russia.
The official visit will begin on November 30 and last for three days.
The trip aims to strengthen bilateral ties and secure energy and investment agreements.

title: Nepal PM India visit LIVE: Balen Shah begins bilateral visit; energy, connectivity on agenda
points: Nepal PM Balen Shah began his first official bilateral foreign visit to India.
Energy and connectivity are key items on the agenda.
He assumed office in March and previously visited the U.S. in September for the UN General Assembly.

title: U.S. panel urges India dialogue for Dalai Lama succession, warns of China legitimacy contest
points: A U.S. Congressional panel urged India to establish a high-level dialogue on the Dalai Lama's succession.
The panel warned of China turning the succession process into an international legitimacy contest.
Recommendations include planning succession contingencies for the 14th Dalai Lama.

title: Core accountability: On core sector performance
points: India's oil and gas sectors failed to show growth despite a low base effect.
The core sector performance highlights ongoing accountability issues.
Analysts are monitoring core sector numbers closely.

title: Rampur’s Lavi Fair: Storytelling through 300 years of Himalayan trade and tradition
points: Rampur’s Lavi Fair in Himachal Pradesh showcases 300 years of Himalayan trade.
The traditional fair has evolved from wool and barter to featuring women entrepreneurs and digital payments.
It highlights Rampur Bushahr's rich cultural heritage.

title: Must balance ‘economic patriotism’ with cultural heritage: GJC on PM Modi’s call to stop gold purchases
points: The GJC commented on the economic contributions of the gold jewellery sector.
The sector contributes nearly 7-8% to India's economy.
It supports millions of livelihoods while balancing cultural heritage with economic priorities.

title: India, Finland seek to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation: Envoy Mikko Kivikoski
points: India and Finland are seeking to deepen economic ties through startup cooperation.
Envoy Mikko Kivikoski emphasized engaging more with Indian startup ecosystems.
Startups are viewed as a vital component of future bilateral cooperation.

title: What does EPFO’s Systematic Withdrawal Plan entail for retirees | Explained
points: The EPFO proposed a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) for retirees.
Members will receive periodic withdrawals instead of a lump-sum amount after superannuation.
It offers multiple options to manage the accumulated PF corpus.

title: How long is too long on the throne?
points: Experts recommend limiting toilet sitting time to a maximum of 5 minutes.
Prolonged sitting while scrolling on phones increases the risk of haemorrhoids.
There is no single magic number of minutes, but 5 minutes is the broad agreement.

title: Alice Huang in touch with Chinese spy agency during affair with Nvidia CEO, says NYT
points: Alice Huang was reported to be in touch with a Chinese spy agency during an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
The report was published by the New York Times.
Spokespersons for Nvidia and the Chinese Embassy did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

title: Private buses in Keralam reported for violations on the new web app Idi Vandi
points: Kerala private buses were reported for violations using a new web app named Idi Vandi.
The app was developed by Bengaluru-based Malayali Hrishikesh Vinod.
It received over 600 complaints within a week of its launch.

title: Bisleri says it’s water ‘safe for consumption’ after FSSAI sanctions prosecution, says it has received no notice
points: FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri regarding water sample quality.
Bisleri stated its water is safe and received no official notice.
The company claimed five of six Goa facility samples met standards in September 2025.

title: India’s recurring pollution crisis calls for a sustained movement for cleaner air
points: India's recurring pollution crisis demands a sustained movement for cleaner air.
The campaign requires public engagement and changes in civic behavior.
Lessons from the Swachh Bharat Mission serve as a template for citizen-led clean air initiatives.

title: Shubman Gill wants ICC to revisit saliva ban, questions quality of Kookaburra ball
points: Shubman Gill called on the ICC to reconsider the saliva ban for cricket balls.
He also raised questions regarding the quality of the Kookaburra ball.
Indian bowlers delivered nearly 250 overs in a drawn match in Wellington.

title: Ind vs SL, third ODI | Kohli, Gill power India to series sweep with record 317-run win
points: Virat Kohli and Shubman Gill powered India to a series sweep against Sri Lanka.
India registered a record 317-run win in the third ODI.
Kohli scored 166 runs and Gill scored 116 runs.

title: IND-W vs SL-W 5th T20: Dominant Team India targets a clean sweep
points: India women's cricket team targeted a clean sweep in the 5th T20 against Sri Lanka.
Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana shared a record opening stand of 162 runs.
This partnership ensured a 4-0 lead and stands as India's highest T20 wicket partnership.

title: AUS vs NED | Maxwell puts on a big show, rips the Netherlands apart
points: Australia defeated the Netherlands by a record margin in a World Cup match.
David Warner scored his sixth World Cup hundred, helping set a total of 399.
Adam Zampa registered his third consecutive four-wicket haul.

title: Explained | When are the new ICC rules coming into play?
points: The ICC introduced new rules regarding 'mankading', saliva use, and hybrid pitches.
Mankading is officially no longer considered unfair play.
Changes address playing conditions and match regulations across formats.

title: Indian Navy Marks 50 Years of Long-Range Maritime Reconnaissance Operations - DD News
points: The Indian Navy marked 50 years of Long-Range Maritime Reconnaissance Operations.
The milestone highlights the Navy's enduring maritime surveillance capabilities.
Celebrations were covered by major news platforms like DD News.

title: Indian Navy to upgrade Barak 1 point defence missile systems - Asian Military Review
points: The Indian Navy plans to upgrade its Barak 1 point defence missile systems.
The upgrade aims to enhance the warships' close-in weapon system capabilities.
Details were reported by the Asian Military Review.

title: India's Defence Strength Powering National Security through Self-Reliance - pib.gov.in
points: India's defence strength continues to focus on national security through self-reliance (Atmanirbharta).
Government releases emphasize indigenous manufacturing in the defence sector.
Updates were published via official PIB releases.

title: Indian Air Force Sukhoi-30MKI Jet Crashes in Assam - News On AIR
points: An Indian Air Force Sukhoi-30MKI fighter jet crashed in Assam.
The incident was reported by News On AIR.
Search and rescue operations were initiated following the crash.

title: Titagarh delivers second diving support craft to Indian Navy - ThePrint
points: Titagarh delivered the second diving support craft to the Indian Navy.
The vessel strengthens the Navy's underwater diving and salvage operations.
The delivery was reported by ThePrint.
